description_en: Queries the list of LoRaWAN join permissions
description_zh: 调用该接口查询LoRaWAN入网凭证列表
name: QueryLoRaJoinPermissions

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
